parsed.name: 通用实验探测器
parsed.description: 一种用于实验室测量的数据探测设备，泛指可输出测量信号或图像的检测仪器，如光电探测器、相机或其他科学传感器。它通常用于采集单次或连续实验数据，并将结果提供给实验控制与分析系统。
parsed.description_en: A laboratory measurement detector used to acquire experimental signals or images, broadly covering instruments such as photodetectors, cameras, or other scientific sensors. It is typically used for single-shot or continuous data acquisition and provides measurement results to laboratory control and analysis systems.

actions.description: 向探测器发送控制命令。
actions.description_en: Send a control command to the detector.

actions.description: 初始化探测器并准备开始测量。
actions.description_en: Initialize the detector and prepare it for measurement.

actions.description: 输出探测器产生的临时测量数据。
actions.description_en: Output temporary measurement data produced by the detector.

actions.description_en: Output measurement data after acquisition is complete.

actions.description_en: Acquire detector data for single-shot or continuous acquisition.

actions.description_en: Close the detector or end the current connection and acquisition.
